yang0-handraw-style-article-cover-design.description: 极简高效的文章与视频封面设计技能。根据输入文章或视频字幕文件自动提炼200字核心摘要、推算受众群体、默认输出微信公众号标准 2.35:1 超宽画幅封面（兼顾X 5:2与安全留白），或按需匹配小红书(3:4)、B站/YouTube/短视频(16:9/9:16)场景；深度协同全库 365 种视觉风格与36种经典配色；视频封面模式自动注入“视频封面设计，网感强，吸引人眼球”，并结合“先设计隐喻再出图，主标题明显，小字少或者没有小字”核心指令，一键输出高质量结构化封面生图提示词。

yang0-handraw-style-article-illustration.description: 深度分析文章脉络，精准规划插图点位与视觉意象。对知识类/教程类文章默认启动“认知降负与高保真图替繁文机制”，严禁删除公式与量化指标，强制协同 167 种排版图型（IG-*信息图/SC-*社媒卡）与 365 种视觉风格/36 种经典配色，杜绝微缩杂物摆拍；对非知识类文章保持叙事氛围与意境。严格执行双向间距（400~1200字）与全篇章节均衡覆盖，支持自主生图或全自动插图回填排版。

yang0-handraw-style-community-share.description: 通用手绘风社区发帖与静态页面/资产发布 Skill。打通 handraw-style.com (Discourse) 官方论坛账号系统与静态画廊发布系统。涵盖双重能力：(1) 全板块论坛发帖与管理（创作交流、好用的工具、综合大厅、运营与变现、实战作品与爆款、手绘skill）：支持发布通用长帖、出版级手绘提示词卡片、自动配图直传短链、回帖、帖子查询与删除；(2) 风格画廊与静态资产一键部署上云（index.html、tutorials.html、assets.html、366 种画风WebP、色彩/版式元数据）与论坛联动公告。触发词：手绘风发帖, 社区发帖, 论坛发帖, 发到论坛, 发到社区, 发布帖子, 分享作品, 手绘提示词分享, 查看我的帖子, 删除帖子, 发布静态页面到社区, 发布静态页, 同步画廊, 更新网站, 部署静态页, 画廊发布.

yang0-handraw-style-couple-photo-orchest.description: Orchestrates professional portrait, couple, wedding, family, cosplay, and themed photography planning from direction selection through Look, scene micro-zones, Shot List, and on-demand image generation.

Confirm portrait, couple, family, group, wedding-party, team, cast, travel, period, or cosplay photo requirements and produce complete per-participant Looks, scenes, props, and a confirmed photography handoff for any number of subjects.
Turn confirmed one-person or multi-person portrait styling handoffs into detailed eight-shot plans, numbered grids, and selected detail-render briefs without reducing per-participant specificity.
Design numbered six-look wardrobe boards for one or any number of participants inside a confirmed portrait theme, preserving full per-person outfit detail.

yang0-handraw-style-custom-asset-manager.description: 管理自建图库（角色库、道具库、场景库）全生命周期资产。支持初始化与挂载图库目录、新增归档资产、替换基准图、修改名称与标签、安全删除资产、查询清单及自动刷新画廊。当用户提出“添加到角色库”、“替换IP图片”、“修改角色名称”、“删除角色/道具/场景”、“初始化图库目录”等资产维护需求时使用。

yang0-handraw-style-couple-photo-orchest.description: Early professional hairstylist node that designs and locks formal shoot hair for each candidate direction before downstream Look expansion.
Mandatory formal-shoot makeup and skin optimization node for portrait photography.

yang0-handraw-style-root.description: Turn a 001–366 hand-drawn and realistic style number and image theme into bilingual prompts, using model capability data to decide when core traits and a numbered reference image are required.

yang0-handraw-style-personal-library.description: 手绘风个人画风、图型与社区收藏的按需同步、离线导入、创建和派生。不修改官方编号库，不自动上传私人内容。

yang0-handraw-style-ip-designer.description: 专业 IP 形象设计与 Character Bible / IP Design Manual 交付体系技能。按策略层、角色层、视觉层、系统层、商业层 5 个层级规划与生成 18 张标准卡片生图提示词。坚持文字简洁、画面聚焦、大图清晰、无示例污染，支持基础版（6张）、标准版（10张）与完整版（18张）按需输出高质量结构化提示词。

yang0-handraw-style-layout-library-impor.description: Add a supplied layout image and bilingual layout prompt to the local handdraw-style layout library and gallery. Use for new SC-* social-card or IG-* infographic layouts; do not use for style-number imports.

yang0-handraw-style-poster-prompt-genera.description: 专门生成极简结构化 AI 海报提示词的专业设计技能。彻底摒弃冗长描述与套路化格式，深度协同项目 365 种视觉风格与 36 种经典主题色画廊，按核心业务与设计字段输出提示词（主题、业务场景、受众、内容密度、情感基调、主题色、editorial风格、画风），让生图模型（如 GPT Image 2/2.5）自主完成原生高质量构图与排版。

yang0-handraw-style-couple-photo-orchest.description: Turns a real-person reference into a reusable polished identity reference through a visual three-panel beauty exploration.

yang0-handraw-style-style-business-analy.description: 专门为手绘与写实视觉风格库（FA-001~FI-034 /

yang0-handraw-style-style-fusion-prompte.description: 跨媒介“角色视觉语言 × 场景视觉语言”双风格共存融合提示词生成技能。支持融合两套不同视觉风格编号（#001–#366），或融合风格编号与写实风格，并可按需注入图型（167 种）与主题色（36种），严格输出造型解耦、物理光影与叙事共存的高质量生图提示词。

yang0-handraw-style-style-library-import.description: Add a named or text-defined visual style to the numbered hand-drawn style library, generating a square representative image without number badges when none is supplied. Do not use for image-only Tweet imports.

yang0-handraw-style-tweet-style-importer.description: Automatically scrape any X/Twitter tweet and its images, assign the next sequential style number, generate a 1024x1024 4-grid generation reference and a 16-grid gallery contact sheet without number badges, register the style, set mandatory image passing, and rebuild the gallery.
